column1: Purpose: Track your daily cold outreach volume across every channel.
1. Fill in the Date for each day.
2. Fill in Emails Sent, LinkedIn DMs Sent, Twitter/X DMs Sent, and Instagram DMs Sent for that day.
3. Replace "Other Outreach Sent #1" with the actual platform name if you use another channel, or remove the column entirely if you don't need it.
5. Fill in Notes if anything is worth flagging.
6. Do this every day, however you need to get it done, whether that's a manual log or an end-of-day report.
